text: Rostec is a state corporation created by the Russian Federation under Federal Law No. 270-FZ of 23 November 2007; the Russian Federation is its founder.
short: Rostec is a state corporation created by the Russian Federation.

source.name: Rostec: About the State Corporation (archived copy of rostec.ru/about/)
source.quote: является юридическим лицом, созданным Российской Федерацией в организационно-правовой форме государственной корпорации
source.note: Translation: '[Rostec] is a legal entity created by the Russian Federation in the organisational-legal form of a state corporation.' Page also notes it acts under Federal Law No. 270-FZ of 23 November 2007.

additionalSources.name: Council Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/581 (EUR-Lex), Annex IV entry for Novikombank
additionalSources.quote: a major Russian state owned defence conglomerate
additionalSources.note: The entry describes Rostec (Russian Technologies State Corporation) as a major Russian state-owned defence conglomerate.
